blockers_in_previous_session: teams-* MCP tools were NOT in this session's tool registry because --mcp teams was added after session start (CLI captures tool manifest at startup).

Agency proxy at 127.0.0.1:53199 exposed only 9 read-only tools (ListTeams, ListChats, ListChannels, GetTeam, GetChat, CreateChat, DeleteChat, UpdateChat, GetChannel) — no PostChannelMessage / ReplyToChannelMessage / ListChannelMessageReplies.
User-managed bluebird-ai OAuth (~/.copilot/mcp-oauth-config/8c36...json) has access_token expired by ~20h AND refresh_token returned HTTP 400 — needs re-auth to use direct-HTTP fallback path.
resume_instructions: Start a fresh Copilot CLI session with --mcp teams from the start (so teams-* tools are in the tool registry). Then ask me to resume: 'resume the teams-remote eval — workspace and IDs are in plugins/general-ops/skills/teams-remote-workspace/iteration-1/eval_state.json'.
next_steps_when_resumed: 1. Verify teams-* MCP tools are callable (try teams-ListTeams).
2. cd into workspace; reuse session_id eval-20260428155629 OR generate a new one (and update transcript files).
3. Run activate.py --step run with team-id/channel-id/user-display from this file.
4. Execute the post_root mcp_call via teams-PostChannelMessage tool. Capture id + createdDateTime to transcript/02_post_root_response.json.
6. Tell user to post 'say hello world' as a REPLY to the root message in LiziTestTeam_MainChannel.
7. Run poll.py --step tick --mode idle --long-poll. Expect inject envelope.
8. Run poll.py --step process with the envelope; post the ack (with @Lior Zivi mention + 'Copilot agent message:' prefix + 'hello world' content) and verify it lands.
9. Run end.py --step run --reason user-invoked; execute the post_summary mcp_call.
10. Run end.py --step finalize. Verify state file under <tempdir>/general-ops/teams-remote/ is gone.
11. Capture all transcripts to with_skill/transcript/ ; capture final outputs (root msg id, reply id, ack id, summary id, state-deleted bool) to with_skill/outputs/run.json.
12. Without-skill baseline: skip the live posts (user agreed it'd just fail) — write a no-skill stub describing the failure mode (agent has no protocol for activation/polling/end).
13. Grade the manual assertions in iteration-1/eval_metadata.json; aggregate; generate the eval-viewer with --static so user can review in browser.
assertions_to_grade: Root activation message posted to LiziTestTeam_MainChannel
Skill detects user reply 'say hello world' via polling
Agent posts 'hello world' answer in thread (via ack or follow-up reply)
End flow posts summary message to thread
State file is deleted after end --step finalize

important_skill_rules_to_honor.ack_must_include: (1) literal 'Copilot agent message:' prefix, (2) leading '@Lior Zivi' literal mention, (3) mentions argument with id+displayName
important_skill_rules_to_honor.transport_switch: If any teams-* call returns -32001/401/AADSTS*, run poll.py --step record-mcp-error then re-tick; envelopes will start carrying transport=http and only http_fallback will be executable.
important_skill_rules_to_honor.stop_hook: scripts/hooks/teams_remote_stop.py blocks turn-end while away_mode=true — treat its 'block reason' as imperative; only end.py --step finalize releases it.
